C0605.title: Beijing Resident's New Mobile Number Logs Directly into Stranger's Cloud Drive Account
C0605.summary: A Beijing resident, Mr. Li, found that his newly activated mobile number directly accessed the previous owner's cloud drive account, which contained family photos, work documents, and scanned contracts.
